stage: 4 — promote Normal-R4 and Calm A into production-clean code; prepare route wiring

verdict.label: PRODUCTION-CLEAN BLOCKERS CLOSED — ready for shadow scheduler wiring
verdict.safety_note: Because B1 is now the last blocker, a valid confirmation file plus TRACK1_ORDERS_APPROVED=1 genuinely ARMS the order gate. Before this stage, releasing B1 still left three gates shut. That is the designed end state, but it means the confirmation file has stopped being one safeguard among several and has become THE safeguard. A test asserts both halves: the file alone does not arm the gate, and both factors together do. The file still does not exist and nothing here creates it.

normal_r4.monkeypatch_proof: a test captures id() of futures._validated_core.backtest_swing_tf, _swing_cache, raits.strategies.trend_follow.TrendFollowStrategy.generate_signal, futures.swing_tf.SwingTFEngine, futures.stress_mid.StressMidEngine and a copy of trend_follow.DEFAULT_CONFIG, runs the generator, and requires all six unchanged. Identity rather than equality, because the scratch path restores them in a finally and would pass an afterwards-only check.

divergences_found_and_fixed.measured: MES exits MAX_HOLD at 09:30 on 2026-01-26 and re-enters at 15:20 the same session; the first pass produced 20 trades where the record has 22
divergences_found_and_fixed.cause: run_loop rescans the window AFTER the exit rather than reading the signal cache, because avgv is positional inside the 14:00-15:55 window so a truncated window gives different averages

divergences_found_and_fixed.measured: without it vault2025 gained trades on 2025-01-02 and 2025-01-10; the record's first trade is 2025-01-21, about fourteen sessions in
divergences_found_and_fixed.cause: the cache builder DROPS a day with no usable daily ATR while the signal wrapper KEEPS it; almost every entry comes through the cache, so dropping is the effective rule

divergences_found_and_fixed.measured: the first run gave MNKD ema_period=50 and it produced a LONG where the record says SHORT
divergences_found_and_fixed.cause: mine — MNKD runs at ema 10; generate() now takes labels and params per instrument

fill_law.default: artifact_all_bars_gappable — what the committed rows were built under
fill_law.open_item: track1_params.fill_law declares production_gap_after_15min_break while the rows every Track 1 number rests on were built under the artifact law. Immaterial in P&L ($0 to +$6 over seven years, measured in the three-blockers report) but the declared identity and the actual data disagree.

calm_a.guard: a test replaces builtins.open and pandas.read_csv and fails the run if the detector path touches scratch/calm_pcloc_not_deep_gap_trade_list.csv

equivalence.why_features_too: matching the same DAYS could happen with a slightly wrong feature and a compensating threshold; matching the recorded values cannot

rule.regime: SPY HMM label at the PRIOR session is Calm
rule.not_deep: current RTH open / prior RTH close - 1 >= -0.010
rule.trade: LONG only, MES and MNQ, entry at the 10:00 OPEN, exit at the 15:55 OPEN

calm_a.thresholds_source: read off the artifact, not fitted — prev_close_loc tops out at exactly 0.333333 and prev_rth_ret at exactly 0.000000 across all 421 rows; the audit states the gap filter verbatim

conventions_discovered.what: entry and exit are bar OPENs
conventions_discovered.evidence: MNQ 2018-01-05: the 10:00 bar's open is 8753.00 and the 15:55 bar's open is 8791.75, matching the row exactly

conventions_discovered.what: the prior session's RTH window ends at 15:59, not 16:00
conventions_discovered.evidence: the frozen row implies a prior close of 8724.50; [09:30,16:00] closes at 8725.75 and [09:30,15:59] at 8724.50, moving close-location from 0.3675 to 0.3248 — across the 1/3 threshold

conventions_discovered.what: a session counts only if it RAN TO that close
conventions_discovered.rejected_alternative: raits.live.trading_calendar calls Christmas Eve and Black Friday trading days, which they are — the exchange is open. With the calendar rule floor lost 5 rows and gained 2; with the ran-to-close rule it is exact.

conventions_discovered.what: the window is a filter on the RESULT, not a slice of the frame
conventions_discovered.evidence: clipping the start lost 2026-01-02 (no prior session); clipping the end lost 2026-08-19 (the end clip is a midnight boundary, so the last day has no 10:00 bar)

wiring.one_constant: run_scheduler._TRACK1_STRESS_WINDOW, asserted equal to track1_slots.REQUIRED_ENTRY_WINDOW and schedule_status.TRACK1_STRESS_WINDOW — the window exists once, not three times

wiring.scope: this closes the WIRING, not the running of it. No scheduler was started and no Track 1 slot has ever fired.

assertion_narrowed_on_purpose: the blanket 'no side effects' fired on Stress, which sets one scratch constant for a call and restores it in a finally. That is a different thing from replacing a production function for a run, so the assertion now bans replacements of futures./raits. symbols rather than side effects in general — banning both would have made the test say something it does not mean.
